description: The source describes a CO2 enhanced-oil-recovery pilot in the Judy Creek Beaverhill Lake A pool. Those statements are source-reported qualitative findings. Report descriptors cover 2008–2010 with appendices, while package dates extend from 2006 to 2011. Exact injection rates, recovery volumes, pressure series and simulation software remain unstated. This is operational experiment information, not proof of permanent CO2 storage. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The licence and reuse terms are not stated. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above.
